resources.string: Wake phrase is fixed to Hey Zero.
Keep quiet briefly for calibration, then say Hey Zero repeatedly with about half a second between phrases. Valid samples are saved automatically until the target is reached.
Measuring ambient noise — keep quiet for about 0.4 seconds.
Ready — say Hey Zero, then pause briefly.
Capturing speech — finish the phrase naturally.
Checking and saving this sample. The count changes only after saving succeeds.
Last saved sample: %1$.2f s · signal/noise %2$.1f dB
Not counted: %1$s Say it again, or stop and re-record.
The sample could not be saved. It was not counted; existing saved samples remain unchanged.
Voice conversation
Open unified voice conversation settings
No native voice conversation model is configured.
The assistant uses the provider and model selected in voice conversation settings. STT/TTS and chat models are not selected separately here.
Changing the app or wake language keeps saved Hey Zero samples. Acoustic samples stay on this device.
Speech is too quiet above the microphone floor. Move closer and speak naturally.
The speech segment is too short. Say the complete Hey Zero phrase.
The segment is too long or has no clear pause. Say one phrase, then pause for half a second.
Background sound masks speech or lacks clear voice structure. Move somewhere quieter.
The microphone signal is distorted. Speak softer or move slightly farther away.
This recording differs too much from the saved phrases. Use a similar speaking pace and distance.
No complete phrase was captured before the waiting limit. Check microphone access and speak after calibration.
The recording resembles a steady tone rather than a spoken phrase. Turn off test tones or music and try again.
Starting a new collection clears the saved samples and acoustic profile and pauses background wake listening. They are replaced only after this storage change succeeds.
Start continuous recording

The assistant uses microphone access and the native model selected in voice conversation settings. Conversation audio is sent to that service. Hey Zero listening is enabled separately, uses a foreground notification and device resources, and keeps its personal acoustic samples on this device. It does not transcribe or verify the spoken words during enrollment.
